headline: Alphabet shares drop 13% on AI spending concerns and earnings miss
summary: Alphabet shares fell nearly 13% after reporting third-quarter earnings per share of $2.12, missing analyst expectations of $2.99. Investors expressed concern over high capital expenditures for AI hardware and slowing advertising revenue growth.
why: Alphabet is a dominant player in digital advertising and cloud computing. Its capital expenditure trends are a bellwether for the broader technology sector's investment in artificial intelligence.

impacts.name: Alphabet Inc.
impacts.why: The earnings miss and concerns over AI-related capital expenditure weighed heavily on investor sentiment.

why_moved: The significant earnings miss combined with investor anxiety regarding the high costs of AI infrastructure triggered a sharp sell-off in the stock.
